title: What Is ERCP?
description: What ERCP (endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: ERCP is an endoscopic procedure to treat stones or blockages in the bile duct and pancreas. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
ERCP is an endoscopic procedure to treat stones or blockages in the bile duct and pancreas.

How is it done?

An endoscope is passed through the mouth to reach the bile duct, where stones are removed or stents are placed.

When is it recommended?

Stones in the bile duct, obstruction or jaundice caused by obstruction. The specialist decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.
